sources.snippet: binghe2727/qwen-2.5-3b-r1-countdown is a 3.1 billion parameter instruction-tuned causal language model, fine-tuned from Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. It was trained using the TRL framework and incorporates the GRPO method, which is designed to enhance mathematical reasoning capabilities. This model is optimized for tasks requiring robust mathematical problem-solving and logical deduction ...
